dt: Expressions of interest by email to Giulia Casarosa (giulia.casarosa@pi.infn.it); the formal call will be published separately, expected in early 2027
e: The Belle II group at INFN Pisa and the University of Pisa is asking for expressions of interest in a research position developing machine-learning anomaly detection for CAEN power-supply monitoring data; it needs a PhD in physics or a related field. A second position on the Belle II vertex detector (VTX) upgrade does not need a PhD and is open to candidates within six years of their Master's degree.
n: INFN Pisa / University of Pisa (Belle II): Research position in machine learning for detector power-supply monitoring (expression of interest)
unv: This is a preliminary request for expressions of interest, not a formal call. Eligibility, salary, contract length and the formal deadline are not yet published; 2026-12-14 is the INSPIRE listing deadline.
